correctness.rationale: The claim counts exactly the kernel/specialized equilibria of a three-state independently reciprocated directed ring. Each noncoherent strict cycle orientation is acyclic and has one kernel; an added reverse arc preserves an existing kernel. This yields the complete zero-kernel event. Every candidate kernel is a cyclic independent dominating word with spacings two or three; its independent orientation-survival weights are u=a(2-a) and v=a². Marked-gap counting and a formal logarithmic derivative derive the weighted Perrin trace formula for all n. The primitive companion matrix and implicit differentiation prove both fixed-r growth and the r~c/n expectation crossover. The eight-edge sink gadget, a binomial count over disjoint windows, and Chernoff concentration prove typical exponential growth for each fixed r>0. The exact checker enumerated 9,828 configurations for n=3..8, gave 60 exact aggregate identities at five rational probabilities, and verified all three gadget boundary choices. The finite checks support, but do not replace, the written universal proof.

broader_coverage.reasoning: A qualitative monotonicity theorem allows the number of equilibria to increase but does not establish whether it remains bounded or grows exponentially typically. Likewise, existence with high probability does not imply exponential multiplicity. The stochastic ring law is strictly more quantitative on this model, without claiming to extend the cited general theorems.

originality.rationale: The closest 2025 primary study proves the kernel correspondence and monotonicity under reciprocation, not an exact random-ring expected-kernel law or a typical exponential-multiplicity threshold. The 2008 Perrin literature covers the r=1 endpoint as a classical special case, which is expressly excluded from novelty. The central new assertion is the all-positive-r high-probability exponential multiplicity with an explicit local gadget and concentration bound, accompanied by exact finite-ring probabilities and an r~1/n expected-count crossover. Searches of related graph-kernel, maximal-independent-set and directed-network records did not identify an equivalent or stronger stochastic-ring theorem; unindexed literature remains a risk.
residual_risks: An unindexed theorem on random partially symmetrized cycle kernels could cover all or part of the result.
A general weighted independent-domination polynomial can imply the exact first-moment expression; the novelty claim rests most strongly on the probabilistic typical exponential-multiplicity theorem.
The publisher full text of Bisdorff–Marichal was not inspected; the accessible abstract explicitly establishes the undirected endpoint.
The explicit high-probability exponent is valid but probably not sharp; no sharp typical entropy constant is claimed.

value.rationale: The directed-public-goods literature motivates estimating robustness of specialist equilibrium under increasing network reciprocity, but its monotonicity result leaves equilibrium multiplicity unquantified. This theorem identifies an exact random-ring survival probability, exact weighted generating law, a natural critical reciprocity window for the mean, and an all-positive-reciprocity transition from bounded to exponentially numerous equilibria with high probability. The last fact is proved by a concrete local switching gadget and is not merely an elementary endpoint calculation.
